In Service of Yalahar Quest

General

Aliases

Yalahar Quest, Yalaharian Outfit Quest

Quest Log

In Service of Yalahar Quest

Requirements

Premium

✓

Level

80
Required after mission 9
(120+ recommended)

Other

Version

8.40
December 10, 2008
Winter Update 2008

Status

Active
See also: Quests

Legend

The new found island of Yalahar needs to be investigated thoroughly.

Location

Edron, Liberty Bay, Yalahar.

Dangers

Lots of creatures on quarters in Yalahar (including Azerus).

Reward

Passage into the innermost area and through the gates to the city quarters; 5 Platinum Coins, choice between Yalahari Mask, Yalahari Armor, Yalahari Leg Piece and Yalahari Footwraps and base Yalaharian Outfits .

Required Equipment

  • Travel money
  • Novice Rank or higher of the Tibian Explorer Society
  • For mission 1: Crowbar or Whacking Driller of Fate
  • Completed all 3 Barbarian Tests
  • For missiong 5: Completed (or bring a friend who has completed) the first mission of Ice Islands Quest (Nibelor: Breaking the Ice)
  • For mission 7: Helmet of the Deep, or Depth Galea
  • To save time and travelling money, get 5 of the following items before starting:
Town Where Item Cost
Thais Gamon (here (32408, 32170, 7)) Piece of Royal Satin 200 gp
Venore Rodney or Livielle (both here (32975, 32038, 6)) Sample of Venorean Spice 200 gp
Ab'Dendriel Brasith (here (32692, 31589, 7)) Bottle of Bug Milk 200 gp
Carlin Florentine (here (32362, 31796, 7)) Bowl of Evergreen Flowers 150 gp
Liberty Bay Lyonel (here (32297, 32831, 7)) Rum Flask (with Rum) 150 gp (can be made)1
Port Hope Elephants Tusk --
Darashia Omur (here (33228, 32416, 7)) Sample of Sand Wasp Honey 200 gp
Ankrahmun Mehkesh (here (33130, 32811, 5)) Jug of Embalming Fluid 200 gp

Notes:

  1. Empty Rum Flasks can be looted from pirates or found as Daily Respawns in various locations, including in one of the pirate ships of the Foreigner Quarter. Armenius sells Mugs of Rum that can be transfered to the Rum Flask.

Rewards

This quest is long and requires level 80, however, the level requirement only applies to the last mission. Only the item and outfit rewards of the quest require level 80, the access to quarter Mechanisms are obtained throughout the quest. The following table summarizes what reward is obtained when.

Reward Objective
5 Platinum Coins 001Complete 'The Way to Yalahar'.
Additional boat routes to and from Yalahar 002Complete 'Searoutes around Yalahar'.
Access to Alchemist Quarter mechanism 03Start mission 3.
Access to Trade Quarter mechanism 04Start mission 4.
Access to Arena Quarter mechanism 05Start mission 5.
Access to Cemetery Quarter mechanism 06Start mission 6.
Access to Sunken Quarter mechanism 07Start mission 7.
Access to Factory Quarter mechanism 08Start mission 8.
1 out of 3 Achievements: Follower of Azerus/Palimuth, Turncoat 11Choose a side in mission 9.
Yalaharian Outfit 11Complete mission 10.
Yalahari Leg Piece, Yalahari Mask, or Yalahari Armor 11Complete mission 10.

Method

The Way to Yalahar

First make sure you are a member of the Explorer Society and have the rank of novice or higher, otherwise you will not be able to talk to Captain Max in Liberty Bay.

Go to Wyrdin in the centre of the Ivory Towers in Edron and talk to him about a mission. He will explain to you that a member of the Tibian Explorer Society is in Yalahar and would like his Research Notes of the unknown city. He will also tell you that Captain Max in Liberty Bay will take you to Yalahar.

Alternatively, as a free account player, head to Wyrdin's Apprentice to the west of Kazordoon and talk to him about Yalahar. You will need to pay him 250 gold for the password (whizzkid), then you can travel from Thais to Yalahar from Captain Bluebear on Thais' boat.

Once in Yalahar, find Timothy just north of depot and ask him for his research notes. He will give them to you and talk about a native friend who is in need of help.

To finish the mission, go back to Wyrdin or Wyrdin's Apprentice and talk to him about the mission. You will be rewarded 500 gold. It is not mandatory to go to Wyrdin to continue the quest.

Searoutes around Yalahar

Finishing this mission is not mandatory either, however it is recommended as it will save you a lot of time and money. It allows you to travel from different cities to Yalahar rather than only from Liberty Bay.

Go to captain Karith in Yalahar east of Captain Cookie, and ask him for a passage. You must give Karith only five (out of 8 possible) of the items described in the Required Equipment section to prove that traveling to other cities will be worth while. It does not matter which ones you handle, the 8 destinations will be unlocked.

Having the 5 items, you must handle them to Karith naming the city from which you acquired them and answering yes to each of them. The items do not need to be handed in at once, but it saves money and time. You will now be able to travel with Karith to these cities: Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais, and Venore. Karith respects the postmen, so the fare will be 10 gp cheaper for those who completed The Postman Missions Quest.

Mission 01: Something Rotten

First, talk to Palimuth, east of Timothy, and ask him for a mission. He will ask you to help with some sewer malfunctions. You will need either a Crowbar or a Whacking Driller of Fate. There will be 4 locations where you need to go that have been marked with an X on your map. They are not very hard to find.






































Browse Map (32804, 31201, 8)






































Browse Map (32804, 31201, 7)

Most locations can be accessed through the Sewer Grate just east of depot. One can only be accessed through the sewer grate far to the north-west, close to the Alchemist Quarter stairs (Guide Edna can mark this on your map). Then report back to Palimuth.

Sewer problem 2
Sewer problem 3
Sewer problem 4

Mission 02: Watching the Watchmen

You have to find all 7 guards. This is a good mission to explore the Quarters of Yalahar.

It is faster by starting on the Foreigner Quarter (south-west), although you can also start at the Magician Quarter (north-east). You need to find the guards in the walls between the Quarters and ask them for their report. They will then give you their report and you can pass through into the next quarter to find the next guard.

The guards' locations are shown on the map below (inside the Quarters and marked with blue flags):



































Browse Map (32792, 31196, 7)

Recommended order: Foreign > Arena > Alchemist > Cemetery > Magician > Sunken > Factory > Trade.

After having all reports from the guards, go back to Palimuth. You can leave through the Magician Quarter, which has no mechanism at the gate.

Mission 03: Death to the Deathbringer

From here onwards you will be able to do the mission following Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). The difficulty is the same for both sides but achievements differ. You will still need to ask mission of Palimuth even if you choose to not help him, otherwise sealed doors will not open.

  • Doing all missions following Palimuth side will give you the achievement Follower of Palimuth. 
  • Following Azerus (Yalahari), you will get the achievement Follower of Azerus.
  • If you do at least one mission from the opposite side, you will get the Turncoat achievement.

Which addon you will get for the outfit in the end is decided on Mission 09: Decision.

Palimuth will give you two notes to read (in the small room on the left) and then send you to his superior for this mission. Yalahari (Azerus) will also ask you to read two notes he gives you and request you help him with a problem in the Alchemist Quarter — he wants you to retrieve an The Alchemists' Formulas as well as kill the 3 plague bearers. Palimuth does npt like the idea of Azerus getting a hold of the formulas and asks you to burn them by using them on an oven. You will now be able to use the mechanism to the Alchemist Quarter.

During this mission, you will face Death Blobs, Mutated Humans, Mutated Rats, Acid Blobs, Slimes, Mutated Tigers and Bog Raiders. First, you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. Then, head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Note that only the player gaining the most experience from each boss will complete that part. So if you are doing this mission with a team, you will need to kill each boss several times.

Additionally, since the Summer Update 2012, the hitpoints and spell damage of the diseased bosses have been reduced (announced here), and a shortcut to Diseased Fred was added.

Players can find Diseased Dan here (32707, 31189, 8), Diseased Bill here (32671, 31123, 7), and Diseased Fred here (32704, 31124, 7).

You may have to face Bog Raiders and Mutated Tigers to get the formulas. Go down the stairs north-east of Diseased Bill and Diseased Fred, then head north-west to the building where the papers are found (here (32700, 31083, 8)). Now you have to choose whether to burn the formulas on an oven or give them to Yalahari (Azerus). If you wish to do good, there is one oven to the west of the box, so it is recommended that you burn them there if you are following that path.

Mission 04: Good to be Kingpin

For this mission, you are asked to go to the Trade Quarter and negotiate or threaten Mr. West. Once again, you will gain access to the mechanism, although if you choose to help Palimuth you will not want to use this.

Mission Dangers Map
Good Side Palimuth asks you to travel through the sewers to Mr. West, avoiding the need to kill his people:
  • Go to the sewers north-west of the depot (32772, 31241, 7), then go south and follow the passage until you find a door.
  • Go through the door and follow the tunnel until the end.
  • Find Mr. West, tell him about your mission.
 Tarantulas, Slimes, and Centipedes








































Browse Map (32781, 31302, 8)
Bad Side Yalahari (Azerus) will ask you to use the gate to the Trade Quarter, killing some of Mr. West's henchmen to showcase determination and power:
  • Use the mechanism and head south-west until you find a quest door. Work your way up to the top of the building.
  • Kill at least one of Mr. West's henchmen on the way. For example, a Smuggler or a Bandit.
  • Head south through another door, where you will find Mr. West.
  • Force him into submission by explaining the mission.
 Bandits, Smugglers, Mad Scientists, Gladiators, Gang Members







































Browse Map (32819, 31300, 7)

Mission 05: Food or Fight

On this mission you are asked to find a druid by the name of Tamerin, on the Arena Quarter, here (32659, 31213, 8). You will get permission to use the gates mechanism.

Yalahari (Azerus) wants you to get Tamerin to breed warbeasts to help them take back control of all the Quarters. Whereas Palimuth begs for you to request that Tamerin breeds cattle for food. But Tamerin will only listen to your mission after you fulfill 2 favors for him:

  • First: bring him a flask of Animal Cure. It can be bought from Siflind on Nibelor
    • You need to have started this mission in order to buy it, as well as the Ice Islands Quest started for access to Nibelor. If you are unable to go to Nibelor, you can ask someone else who has the quest and access to get it for you, as long as they are on this current mission.
  • Second: kill Morik the Gladiator and bring his helmet as proof. He is located here (32685, 31242, 6), at the last room going around clockwise on the first floor.

Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice:

  • Asking for Cattle will help Palimuth (good side)
  • Asking for Warbeasts will help Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
Tamerin
Morik the Gladiator

Mission 06: Frightening Fuel

Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now.

Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room. Kill Tormented Ghosts and use the Ghost Residue on the charm thrice — this will make 2 more Tormented Ghosts appear. At this point the Ghost Charm will then change into a Charged Ghost Charm.

  • When choosing the Good side: go to Palimuth, ask him about the mission, and hand in the charm.
  • When choosing the Bad side: go to Yalahari (Azerus), ask him about the mission, and give it back.

Mission 07: A Fishy Mission

  • Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission — to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. These bosses can sometimes do a lot of damage.
  • Good side: rather than fighting any Quara leaders, Palimuth's mission will send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima (here (32905, 31167, 13)), ask her about the Quara, and she will explain what their problem is.

You will now need a Helmet of the Deep or a Depth Galea as you are going underwater on the Sunken Quarter. Many Quara will be faced during this mission. Talk to Tarak (here (32917, 31199, 7)), ask him for a trip there. Wear your helmet and jump into the water.

The maps below are a suggestion, they indicate the way to navigate while encountering less of the strong quara. The green areas are the places you will go for the Yalahari's bad side, whereas the yellow shows Palimuth's good side. Until the 2nd map, there will only be Quara Constrictors and Quara Mantassins. On the last floor, there are also Quara Hydromancers, Quara Pinchers, and Quara Predators.

Mission 08: Dangerous Machinations

For this mission, the Yalahari requests you to go to the Factory Quarter and find a pattern crystal, which will be used to supply weapons to help take control of the city. Palimuth will send you there to use the crystal to supply food for the city.

Mission Dangers Maps
Good Side
  • Go down the hole here (32877, 31268, 7).
  • Go down here (32884, 31267, 8).
  • Go down again, here (32887, 31278, 9).
  • Walk north, turn left, and then north again.
  • Reach the Food Matrix Crystal behind a quest door, here (32869, 31265, 10).
 Damaged Worker Golems, Worker Golems
Bad Side
  • Go down a hole here (32936, 31257, 7).
  • Go down here (32935, 31247, 8).
  • Walk to the east, here (32940, 31246, 9), and reach the Weapon Matrix Crystal.
 Worker Golems
Both Sides
  • Go down the hole here (32879, 31268, 7).
  • Walk north, go through the quest door.
  • Walk to the Mysterious Machine in the north and use it to activate it.
  • Use either the Food Matrix Crystal or the Weapon Matrix Crystal on the machine.
  • Once the decision is made and the Mysterious Machine is activated, return to Yalahari.
 Damaged Worker Golems, Worker Golems

Mission 09: Decision

You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. You must first say mission to both of them, to which they will both tell you you need to decide between themself or the other.

  • Good side: to choose Palimuth's side, go to him, and simply ask him for a mission again.
  • Bad side: to choose Yalahari (Azerus)' side, go to him and say mission.

Whomever you choose will ask you if you are choosing them, and then just say yes to confirm your decision. This will complete mission 9.

Depending on your previous choices, you will obtain one of the following achievements:

  • Follower of Azerus - when the bad side was chosen for all missions.
  • Follower of Palimuth - when the good side was chosen for all missions.
  • Turncoat - when a mix of good and bad side missions were done.
  • None: if all missions were done on one side, but at this mission it was decided to choose the other side (i.e., did all Palimuth's good missions and joined Azerus, or vice versa).

You can now ask for the next mission.

Mission 10: The Final Battle

Depending on the player's level, a team or stronger helpers might be needed. Lower level players will have issues due to damage and mana drain. Be aware that there is a time limit of around 12 minutes to kill Azerus.

Someone who has not done the quest yet has to click on the machine at the center of the room to start the fight:

  • Azerus will first appear with Rift Worms — kill the Rift Worms and ignore Azerus as he is extremely hard to kill at this point.
  • Azerus will then teleport to another place in the room and summon Rift Broods, use Earth Damage on them while still ignoring Azerus.
  • Azerus will then summon Rift Scythes, use Fire Damage.
  • Azerus will then summon War Golems, but now it will be much easier to damage Azerus, so focus on Azerus while ignoring the golems.
  • Once Azerus is dead, his body will turn into a Magic Forcefield. All players must step in the forcefield and be teleported to a room where many rift monsters can be seen from above. The message You have a very bad feeling about this... will be displayed.
  • Walk to the most northern point in the room (as shown in the image below). The quest is finished for the character once the message It seems by defeating Azerus you have stopped this army from entering your world! Better leave this ghastly place forever. is displayed.
Notice the damage done on Cachero on the left
After entering the Magic Forcefield

Rewards

Report back to Palimuth to receive the Yalaharian Outfits , as well as access to the reward room located here (32780, 31206, 7). You may only select one item. Starting from the northernmost chest, the rewards are:

  • Yalahari Armor - worn only by Knights.
  • Yalahari Leg Piece - worn only by Paladins.
  • Yalahari Mask - worn only by Sorcerers and Druids.
  • Yalahari Footwraps - worn only by Monks.

To obtain the addon for the Yalaharian Outfits, you must complete the Blood Brothers Quest.
